cases.facts: pottery studio | 18 glaze tests | kiln A reaches 1180 C | kiln B reaches 1240 C | two glazes have no temperature label | firing due tonight
cases.prompt:
Write the short update a staff member would send to the people affected. Tell them what is known and what they should do now. Use one paragraph suitable for a plain-text message. Aim for 55 to 85 words. Do not sign or identify yourself. Return only the requested writing.

pottery studio | 18 glaze tests | kiln A reaches 1180 C | kiln B reaches 1240 C | two glazes have no temperature label | firing due tonight

openai/gpt-6.2-astra.text: Tonight’s firing is scheduled for 18 glaze tests, but two glazes have no temperature label. Kiln A reaches 1180 C and kiln B reaches 1240 C. Before loading, check each glaze’s recommended firing range against the planned firing temperature. Set aside any tests using either unlabeled glaze and check the original packaging or the manufacturer’s instructions. If you can’t confirm the firing range tonight, leave those tests out.

anthropic/claude-fable-5.2.text: Tonight's firing includes 18 glaze tests, but two of them have no temperature label, so we can't yet tell which kiln they belong in. Kiln A reaches 1180 C and kiln B reaches 1240 C, and a glaze fired at the wrong temperature may fail or damage shelves. If you submitted a test, please check your notes and reply with its firing temperature before loading begins. Any test still unidentified will be held back for a later firing.

openai/gpt-6.2-sol.text: Tonight’s firing is scheduled for 18 glaze tests. Kiln A reaches 1180°C and kiln B reaches 1240°C. Two tests are missing firing-temperature labels and will be held out unless their required temperatures can be confirmed before loading. Please check your test labels before tonight’s firing. If one is yours, send the studio its glaze name and confirmed firing temperature. If you’re unsure of the temperature, leave the test out of both kilns.
